s00-01-story-2b56cc.wav.text: A man cuts down a tree and splits the log in half.

s00-02-story-73fa42.wav.text: Half of it, he burns to cook his dinner.

s00-03-story-aa668c.wav.text: The other half, he carves into a statue, and kneels down in front of it.

s00-04-grave-9d116d.wav.text: He prays to it and says, Deliver me, for you are my god!

s00-06-story-61fd4a.wav.text: One half is firewood, and the other half is his god.

s00-07-talk-250e99.wav.text: The prophet Isaiah tells it as a joke.

s00-08-story-93c0a7.wav.text: But behind it is a real question.

s00-09-pivot-bf0392.wav.text: What's actually wrong with a statue of God?

s01-01-talk-0799f1.wav.text: Right after no other gods comes the second commandment.

s01-02-grave-b57b4a.wav.text: You shall not make for yourself a carved image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above,

s01-03-grave-c30be7.wav.text: or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

s01-04-grave-3e3e21.wav.text: You shall not bow down to them or serve them.

s01-05-talk-a247f0.wav.text: It's not mainly about other religions' idols.

s01-06-story-18d242.wav.text: That was the first commandment's job.

s01-07-pivot-3be64e.wav.text: The first is about which God you worship.

s01-09-talk-5a3d0e.wav.text: Even the right God can be worshipped the wrong way.

s02-01-talk-7ca612.wav.text: Notice the list: sky, land and sea.

s02-03-story-094e19.wav.text: Nothing God made can stand in for the God who made it.

s03-01-story-bcaa44.wav.text: Why be so strict about it? Go back to the mountain.

s03-02-talk-79e7b6.wav.text: Moses later reminds Israel what they saw there.

s03-03-grave-6d77ab.wav.text: Then the LORD spoke to you out of the midst of the fire.

s03-04-grave-82da55.wav.text: You heard the sound of words, but saw no form; there was only a voice.

s03-05-talk-3ef8e8.wav.text: Their biggest meeting with God, and nobody saw a shape.

s03-07-story-4b56a1.wav.text: God didn't give them something to look at.

s03-08-story-f1ec67.wav.text: He gave them someone to listen to.

s04-01-pivot-46e1e3.wav.text: So here's the problem with a statue.

s04-02-talk-77de54.wav.text: It makes God smaller, because anything you carve is less than the one who made you.

s04-03-talk-a5272c.wav.text: And it makes God quieter, because a statue only says what you put into it.

s04-05-story-02b991.wav.text: They called it a feast to the LORD.

s04-06-story-ea6f74.wav.text: They weren't replacing God. They were trying to hold him.

s04-07-grave-9c944b.wav.text: A god you can hold is a god you can control.

s04-09-story-b093eb.wav.text: And a God who speaks can tell you things you'd rather not hear.

s05-02-story-f6dad4.wav.text: God already has an image on earth.

s05-03-grave-412530.wav.text: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him; male and female he created them.

s05-04-talk-77d5ef.wav.text: The image of God isn't gold or wood, it's people.

s05-05-talk-1202aa.wav.text: Christians have long read it this way: you don't carve God's image.

s05-06-story-0677ee.wav.text: You meet it, in the person next to you.

s06-01-talk-00726d.wav.text: We may never kneel to a statue.

s06-02-story-26cace.wav.text: But we still carve, just not with wood.

s06-03-story-909046.wav.text: We carve a God who always agrees with us.

s06-04-story-09bf07.wav.text: A God who never says what we don't want to hear.

s06-05-talk-8c5a09.wav.text: Those gods are easy to live with, and much too small.

s07-01-story-31ab04.wav.text: The commandment ends with a warning.

s07-02-story-63f9eb.wav.text: Turning away echoes to the third and fourth generation.

s07-04-grave-295d17.wav.text: but showing steadfast love to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

s07-06-story-e4c60c.wav.text: The warning is heavy. The mercy is heavier.

s07-07-grave-2af48b.wav.text: So put down the carving knife.

s07-08-story-979081.wav.text: The real God isn't waiting to be made.

s07-10-story-d882f9.wav.text: And next time, we'll hear what he says about his name.
